rules.name: Automated Dispute Trigger
rules.statement: The system must automatically generate a Dispute Ticket immediately upon receipt of a Delivery Proof indicating a delivery exception.
rules.condition: When a Delivery Proof indicates a delivery exception
rules.if_violated: Manual intervention delays resolution and increases operational costs
rules.rationale: Ensures consistent and immediate response to delivery exceptions without relying on manual oversight

rules.name: Refund Precondition
rules.statement: Financial adjustments must not be finalized until the Dispute Ticket is marked as Resolved.
rules.condition: During the financial settlement phase of a dispute
rules.if_violated: Revenue leakage or incorrect financial reporting occurs
rules.rationale: Prevents premature financial settlement before the dispute outcome is legally and operationally confirmed

parameters.name: max_pending_days
parameters.description: Maximum days a ticket can remain unresolved before escalation

rules.name: Conflict of Interest
rules.statement: An actor must not approve a Dispute Ticket where they are the accused party.
rules.condition: When an actor is assigned to approve a Dispute Ticket
exceptions: No alternative approver available and authorized by Platform Operator
rules.if_violated: Bias in dispute resolution compromises brand reputation and trust
rules.rationale: Ensures impartial adjudication of disputes to maintain fairness and service standards

parameters.name: escalation_level
parameters.description: Level of supervisor required for conflict override

rules.name: Quality Dispute Authority
rules.statement: Disputes regarding product quality must be approved by the Store Partner.
rules.condition: When a Dispute Ticket involves product quality issues
exceptions: Store Partner is unavailable and escalated to Fulfillment Supervisor
rules.if_violated: Incorrect quality claims lead to inventory discrepancies or reputational damage
rules.rationale: Ensures the entity responsible for fulfillment validates quality-related claims

parameters.name: escalation_timeout
parameters.description: Time limit before escalation to supervisor

rules.name: Settlement Post-Proof Constraint
rules.statement: Financial distribution must not occur until a valid Delivery Proof is recorded.
rules.condition: When initiating revenue distribution for a delivered order
exceptions: Force majeure events declared by the Platform Operator
rules.if_violated: The settlement process is automatically halted and flagged for manual review
rules.rationale: Prevents payment for goods that were never successfully delivered to the customer

parameters.name: valid_delivery_proof_threshold
parameters.description: The specific proof type required to trigger settlement eligibility

rules.name: Agreement Validity Gate
rules.statement: A Financial Transaction Record must not be finalized if no active Store Partner Agreement exists for the involved Store Partner.
rules.condition: During the finalization phase of a Financial Transaction Record
exceptions: Legacy transactions processed under grandfathered clauses defined in the Store Partner Agreement
rules.if_violated: The transaction remains in a pending state and cannot be settled
rules.rationale: Ensures all revenue shares are calculated according to current, legally binding commercial terms

parameters.name: active_agreement_status
parameters.description: The status flag indicating the agreement is currently effective and not terminated

rules.name: High-Risk Manual Override
rules.statement: Transactions exhibiting high-risk indicators may only proceed to settlement after manual verification by a Fulfillment Supervisor.
rules.condition: When a transaction is flagged with high-risk indicators by the system
exceptions: Automated whitelisting for verified low-risk recurring partners
rules.if_violated: The transaction is automatically paused and the settlement cycle is interrupted
rules.rationale: Mitigates financial loss from fraud or erroneous transactions before funds are released

parameters.name: high_risk_indicator_threshold
parameters.description: The criteria level that triggers a mandatory manual review

rules.name: Multi-Currency Conversion Accuracy
rules.statement: Multi-currency transactions must only be settled using real-time exchange rates provided by the Payment Provider at the moment of settlement.
rules.condition: When processing a Financial Transaction Record involving multiple currencies
exceptions: Pre-agreed fixed exchange rates specified in the Store Partner Agreement for specific periods
rules.if_violated: The settlement amount is recalculated and corrected, potentially triggering a refund or additional charge
rules.rationale: Ensures accurate financial reconciliation and prevents currency fluctuation disputes

parameters.name: real_time_exchange_rate_source
parameters.description: The external data feed used to determine the conversion rate

rules.name: Predictive Demand Threshold Enforcement
rules.statement: The system must not allocate inventory to an Order Request if the predictive demand model forecasts a stockout probability exceeding the configured safety margin within the target delivery window.
rules.condition: when allocating inventory for a new Order Request
exceptions: Emergency override by Platform Operator with audit trail
rules.if_violated: The system rejects the allocation and flags the Order Request for manual review to prevent overselling.
rules.rationale: Prevents financial loss and reputational damage caused by overselling items that are likely to be unavailable by the promised delivery time.

parameters.name: stockout probability threshold
parameters.description: maximum acceptable probability of running out of stock before delivery

rules.name: Expiry-Driven Allocation Priority
rules.statement: The system must prioritize the allocation of 'nearing expiry' items to incoming Order Requests over items with longer remaining shelf life, provided the item is within the configured safety margin.
rules.condition: when multiple stores or items can fulfill an Order Request
rules.if_violated: The system defaults to standard nearest-store logic, potentially increasing waste and reducing store partner margins.
rules.rationale: Optimizes inventory turnover and reduces waste by selling perishable goods before they expire.

parameters.name: expiry priority weight
parameters.description: multiplier applied to allocation score for items nearing expiry

rules.name: Forecast-Adjusted Replenishment Trigger
rules.statement: The system must generate a replenishment alert for an item when the projected demand for the next delivery window exceeds the current inventory level by the configured safety stock percentage.
rules.condition: when updating inventory forecasts based on real-time sales velocity
rules.if_violated: The system continues to accept orders for insufficient stock, leading to potential overselling and customer dissatisfaction.
rules.rationale: Ensures supply meets predicted demand to maintain high fulfillment accuracy and customer satisfaction.

parameters.name: safety stock percentage
parameters.description: buffer percentage above projected demand required to trigger alert

rules.name: Dynamic Fee Adjustment for Congestion
rules.statement: The system must increase delivery fees and commissions for a specific Store Partner if the predictive model indicates network congestion will cause delivery times to exceed the target window.
rules.condition: when real-time network data indicates high order volume relative to agent capacity
rules.if_violated: The system accepts orders at standard rates, risking SLA breaches and increased operational costs.
rules.rationale: Balances revenue streams and cost control by adjusting pricing based on predicted operational strain.

parameters.name: congestion threshold
parameters.description: ratio of incoming orders to available agents that triggers fee adjustment

rules.name: Primary Provider Failure Fallback
rules.statement: The Order Allocation Engine must automatically reassign an order to an alternative logistics provider when the primary external provider fails to confirm availability within the timeout window.
rules.condition: when the primary external logistics provider or mapping service returns an error or timeout during order allocation
exceptions: manual override by a supervisor for strategic reasons
rules.if_violated: the system proceeds with a failed allocation, leading to order cancellation and potential revenue loss
rules.rationale: to maintain ultra-fast delivery promises and prevent service interruptions during third-party outages

parameters.name: timeout_window
parameters.description: maximum time allowed to wait for primary provider confirmation before triggering fallback

rules.name: Alternative Route Recalculation
rules.statement: The system must recalculate the optimal delivery path using an alternative mapping service whenever the primary mapping service data is deemed unreliable or unavailable.
rules.condition: when the primary mapping service data is flagged as unreliable or the service connection is lost
rules.if_violated: delivery estimates become inaccurate, causing missed delivery windows and customer dissatisfaction
rules.rationale: to ensure accurate ETA predictions and efficient routing despite external service failures

parameters.name: data_reliability_threshold
parameters.description: minimum confidence level required for primary mapping data to be considered valid

rules.name: Vendor Diversification Limit
rules.statement: The system may only assign an order to a secondary vendor if the total number of active vendors serving that specific order does not exceed the maximum allowed vendor count.
rules.condition: when initiating a fallback assignment to a secondary vendor
exceptions: emergency disaster recovery scenarios defined in the Business Continuity Plan
rules.if_violated: the order becomes unmanageable due to conflicting instructions from multiple vendors
rules.rationale: to prevent operational chaos and ensure clear accountability during fallback scenarios

parameters.name: max_active_vendors
parameters.description: maximum number of vendors allowed to be active for a single order simultaneously

rules.name: Fallback Settlement Verification
rules.statement: Financial settlement for a fallback-assigned order must only proceed after confirming that the new logistics provider has successfully recorded a valid Delivery Proof.
rules.condition: when an order has been reassigned to a fallback logistics provider
rules.if_violated: funds are distributed without proof of delivery, resulting in financial loss and fraud risk
rules.rationale: to ensure that revenue is only recognized when the fallback delivery is successfully completed

parameters.name: delivery_proof_validity
parameters.description: criteria defining a valid delivery proof for fallback orders
